40020972.author: पदार्थः
40020972.content: कैलासं Kailasam, Kailasa mountain, लङ्घयित्वाथ laṅghayitvā atha, having crossed, then, दशग्रीवः daśagrīvaḥ, ten-necked, स sa, that, रावणः rāvaṇaḥ, Ravana, आससाद āsasāda, reached, महातेजा mahātejā, greatly powerful, इन्द्रलोकं indralokaṃ, Indra's world, निशाचरः niśācaraḥ, night-wanderer.

40020972.author: Translation
40020972.content: After crossing the Kailasa mountain, that greatly powerful ten-necked demon Ravana reached the world of Indra.

40020973.author: पदार्थः
40020973.content: तस्य tasya, of that, राक्षससैन्यस्य rākṣasasainyasya, of the demon army, समन्तादुपयास्यतः samantādupayāsyataḥ, approaching from all sides, देवलोकं devalokaṃ, to the world of gods, ययौ yayau, went, शब्दो śabdo, sound, मथ्यमानार्णवोपमः mathyamānārṇavopamaḥ, like the churning ocean.

40020973.author: Translation
40020973.content: The sound of that demon army approaching from all sides reached the world of the gods, resembling the roar of a churning ocean.

40020974.author: पदार्थः
40020974.content: श्रुत्वा śrutvā, having heard, तु tu, indeed, रावणं rāvaṇaṃ, Ravana, प्राप्तम् prāptam, arrived, इन्द्रश्चलित indraścalita, Indra moved, आसनात् āsanāt, from his seat, अब्रवीत्तत्र abravīttatra, spoke there, तान् tān, to those, देवान् devān, gods, सर्वानेव sarvāneva, all indeed, समागतान् samāgatān, assembled.

40020974.author: Translation
40020974.content: Having heard that Ravana had arrived, Indra moved from his seat and spoke to all the assembled gods there.

40020975.author: पदार्थः
40020975.content: आदित्यान्सवसून्रुद्रान्विश्वान्साध्यान्मरुद्गणान् ādityānsavasūnrudrānviśvānsādhyānmarudgaṇān, Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Vishvas, Sadhyas, Maruts, सज्जीभवत sajjībhavata, be ready, युद्धार्थं yuddhārthaṃ, for battle, रावणस्य rāvaṇasya, of Ravana, दुरात्मनः durātmanaḥ, the evil-minded.

40020975.author: Translation
40020975.content: He commanded the Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Vishvas, Sadhyas, and Maruts to prepare for battle against the evil-minded Ravana.

40020976.author: पदार्थः
40020976.content: एवमुक्तास्तु evamuktāstu, thus spoken indeed, शक्रेण śakreṇa, by Indra, देवाः devāḥ, gods, शक्रसमा śakrasamā, equal to Indra, युधि yudhi, in battle, सन्नह्य sannahya, having armored themselves, सुमहासत्त्वा sumahāsattvā, very great-spirited, युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः yuddhaśraddhāsamanvitāḥ, filled with eagerness for battle.

40020976.author: Translation
40020976.content: Thus addressed by Indra, the gods, who were as mighty as Indra in battle and possessed great courage, armored themselves, filled with eagerness for the fight.

40020977.author: पदार्थः
40020977.content: सः he, तु indeed, दीनः distressed, परित्रस्तः greatly frightened, महेन्द्रः Mahendra (Indra), रावणं Ravana, प्रति towards, विष्णोः of Vishnu, समीपम् near, आगत्य having come, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40020977.author: Translation
40020977.content: Distressed and greatly frightened by Ravana, Indra indeed approached Vishnu and spoke these words.

40020978.author: पदार्थः
40020978.content: विष्णो O Vishnu, कथं how, करिष्यामि shall I act, महावीर्यपराक्रमः of great valor and might, असौ this one, हि indeed, बलवत् powerful, रक्षः demon, युद्धार्थम् for battle, अभिवर्तते approaches.

40020978.author: Translation
40020978.content: O Vishnu, how shall I act, for this demon of great valor and might, this powerful Rakshasa, is indeed approaching for battle.

40020979.author: पदार्थः
40020979.content: वरप्रदानात् due to the boon, बलवान् powerful, न not, खलु indeed, अन्येन by any other, हेतुना reason, तत् that, तु indeed, सत्यवचः true word, कार्यं should be made, यत् which, उक्तं was spoken, पद्मयोनिना by Brahma.

40020979.author: Translation
40020979.content: He is powerful due to the boon granted, and not for any other reason; therefore, that true word spoken by Brahma must indeed be fulfilled.

40020980.author: पदार्थः
40020980.content: तत् therefore, यथा just as, नमुचिः Namuchi, वृत्रः Vritra, बलिः Bali, नरक Naraka, शम्बरौ and Shambara, त्वद्बलं your strength, समवष्टभ्य having relied upon, मया by me, दग्धाः were destroyed, तथा so, कुरु do.

40020980.author: Translation
40020980.content: Therefore, just as Namuchi, Vritra, Bali, Naraka, and Shambara were destroyed by me with the support of your strength, so too act now.

40020981.author: पदार्थः
40020981.content: न not, हि indeed, अन्यः another, देवदेवेश O Lord of gods, त्वाम् you, ऋते without, मधुसूदन O Madhusudana, गतिः refuge, परायणं ultimate resort, न not, अस्ति is, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, सचराचरे with all moving and non-moving beings.

40020981.author: Translation
40020981.content: Indeed, O Lord of gods, O Madhusudana, there is no other refuge or ultimate resort in the three worlds, with all their moving and non-moving beings, except for you.

40020982.author: पदार्थः
40020982.content: त्वं you, हि indeed, नारायणः Narayana, श्रीमान् glorious, पद्मनाभः lotus-navelled, सनातनः eternal, त्वया by you, इमे these, स्थापिताः established, लोकाः worlds, शक्रः Indra, च and, अहं I, सुरेश्वरः lord of gods.

40020982.author: Translation
40020982.content: Indra acknowledges Rama as the glorious, eternal Narayana, the lotus-navelled one, by whom all these worlds, including Indra himself as the lord of gods, were established.

40020983.author: पदार्थः
40020983.content: त्वया by you, सृष्टम् created, इदं this, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings, त्वाम् into you, एव indeed, भगवन् O Lord, सर्वे all, प्रविशन्ति enter, युगक्षये at the dissolution of the age.

40020983.author: Translation
40020983.content: Indra further states that all these three worlds, with their moving and non-moving beings, were created by the Lord, and at the end of an age, all beings ultimately merge back into Him.

40020984.author: पदार्थः
40020984.content: तत् therefore, आचक्ष्व tell, यथा how, तत्त्वं truly, देवदेव O God of gods, मम to me, स्वयम् yourself, अपि whether, चक्रसहायः aided by your discus, त्वं you, योत्स्यसे will fight, रावणं Ravana, प्रभो O Lord.

40020984.author: Translation
40020984.content: Indra implores the Lord of gods to reveal truly how He, even with the aid of His discus, intends to fight Ravana.

40020985.author: पदार्थः
40020985.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, सः that, शक्रेण by Indra, देवः god, नारायणः Narayana, प्रभुः the Lord, अब्रवीत् said, न not, परित्रासः great fear, कर्तव्यः should be entertained, श्रूयतां let it be heard, च and, मे by me.

40020985.author: Translation
40020985.content: Thus addressed by Indra, the Lord Narayana replied that there was no need for such great fear, and asked Indra to listen to His words.

40020986.author: पदार्थः
40020986.content: न not, तावत् indeed, एषः this, दुष्टात्मा evil-souled one, शक्यः possible, जेतुम् to conquer, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, हन्तुं to kill, च and, अपि even, समासाद्य having approached, वरदानेन by the boon, दुर्जयः unconquerable.

40020986.author: Translation
40020986.content: The Lord explained that this evil-souled Ravana is currently unconquerable by gods or asuras, and cannot be killed even if approached, due to the boon he has received.

40020987.author: पदार्थः
40020987.content: सर्वथा certainly, तु indeed, महत्कर्म a great deed, करिष्यति will perform, बलोत्कटः exceedingly powerful, राक्षसः the demon, पुत्रसहितो along with his sons, दृष्टम् seen, एतत् this, निसर्गतः by nature.

40020987.author: Translation
40020987.content: It is inherently observed that this exceedingly powerful demon, along with his sons, will certainly perform a great deed.

40020988.author: पदार्थः
40020988.content: यत् that which, तु but, माम् me, त्वम् you, अभाषिष्ठ spoke, युद्ध्यस्व fight, इति thus, सुरेश्वर O lord of gods, न not, अहम् I, तम् him, प्रतियोत्स्यामि will fight against, रावणम् Ravana, राक्षसम् the demon, युधि in battle.

40020988.author: Translation
40020988.content: O lord of gods, regarding what you told me to fight, I will not fight against that demon Ravana in battle.

40020989.author: पदार्थः
40020989.content: न not, अहत्वा without killing, समरे in battle, शत्रुम् the enemy, विष्णुः Vishnu, प्रतिनिवर्तते returns, दुर्लभः difficult to obtain, च and, एव indeed, कामः the desire, अद्य now, वरगुप्तात् protected by boons, हि indeed, रावणात् from Ravana.

40020989.author: Translation
40020989.content: Vishnu does not return from battle without killing the enemy, and indeed, it is difficult to fulfill this desire now because Ravana is protected by boons.

40020990.author: पदार्थः
40020990.content: प्रतिजाने I promise, च and, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, त्वत्समीपे in your presence, शतक्रतो O Shatakratu, भविता will be, अस्मि I am, यथा as, अस्य of this, अहम् I, रक्षसः of the demon, मृत्युकारणम् the cause of death.

40020990.author: Translation
40020990.content: And O king of gods, O Shatakratu, I promise in your presence that I shall indeed be the cause of this demon's death.

40020991.author: पदार्थः
40020991.content: अहम् I, एव alone, निहन्ता the killer, अस्मि I am, रावणम् Ravana, सपुरःसरम् along with his followers, देवताः the gods, नन्दयिष्यामि I will gladden, ज्ञात्वा having known, कालम् the time, उपागतम् arrived, एतत् this, ते to you, कथितम् told, तत्त्वम् the truth, देवराज O king of gods, शचीपते O husband of Shachi.

40020991.author: Translation
40020991.content: I alone will be the killer of Ravana along with his followers, and I will gladden the gods, knowing that the time has come; this truth has been told to you, O king of gods, husband of Shachi.

40020992.author: पदार्थः
40020992.content: युद्ध्यस्व fight, विगतत्रासः fearless, सर्वैः with all, सार्धम् together, महाबल O mighty one.

40020992.author: Translation
40020992.content: O mighty one, fight fearlessly together with all.

40020993.author: पदार्थः
40020993.content: यामि I go, ज्ञात्वा having known, कालम् time, उपागतम् arrived. ततः then, रुद्राः the Rudras, सह with, आदित्याः the Adityas, वसवः the Vasus, मरुतः the Maruts, अश्वनौ the two Ashvins, सन्नद्धाः ready for battle, निर्ययुः went forth, तूर्णम् quickly, राक्षसान् towards the Rakshasas, अभितः around, पुरात् from the city.

40020993.author: Translation
40020993.content: Knowing that the time had come, I depart; then, the Rudras along with the Adityas, Vasus, Maruts, and the two Ashvins, arrayed for battle, quickly sallied forth from the city towards the Rakshasas.

40020994.author: पदार्थः
40020994.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, नादः a sound, शुश्रुवे was heard, रजनीक्षये at the end of the night, तस्य of that, रावणसैन्यस्य of Ravana's army, प्रयुद्धस्य fighting, समन्ततः from all sides.

40020994.author: Translation
40020994.content: In the meantime, at the end of the night, a roar was heard from all sides from Ravana's army, which was engaged in battle.

40020995.author: पदार्थः
40020995.content: ते they, प्रयुद्धाः fighting, महावीर्याः of great valor, हि indeed, अन्योन्यम् each other, अभिवीक्ष्य having looked at, वै indeed, सङ्ग्रामम् battle, एव only, अभिमुखाः facing, हि indeed, अभवर्तन्त they advanced, हृष्टवत् joyfully.

40020995.author: Translation
40020995.content: Those mighty heroes, engaged in battle, looked at each other and advanced joyfully, intent only on the fight.

40020996.author: पदार्थः
40020996.content: ततः then, दैवतसैन्यानाम् of the armies of the gods, सङ्क्षोभः agitation, समजायत arose, तत् that, अक्षयम् inexhaustible, महासैन्यम् great army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, समरमूर्धनि at the forefront of the battle.

40020996.author: Translation
40020996.content: Then, seeing that immense and inexhaustible great army at the forefront of the battle, agitation arose among the armies of the gods.

40020997.author: पदार्थः
40020997.content: ततो then, युद्धं a battle, समभवेत् occurred, देवदानवरक्षसाम् of gods, demons, and rakshasas, घोरं terrible, तुमुलनिर्ह्रादं with tumultuous roars, नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् with various weapons raised.

40020997.author: Translation
40020997.content: Then, a terrible battle ensued among the gods, demons, and rakshasas, marked by tumultuous roars and the brandishing of various weapons.

40020998.author: पदार्थः
40020998.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, शूराः valiant, राक्षसाः rakshasas, घोरदर्शनाः of terrible appearance, युद्धार्थं for battle, समवर्तन्त assembled, सचिवाः ministers, रावणस्य of Ravana, ते they.

40020998.author: Translation
40020998.content: In the meantime, Ravana's valiant ministers, the rakshasas of terrible appearance, assembled for battle.

40020999.author: पदार्थः
40020999.content: मारीचः Maricha, च and, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, च and, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparshva and Mahodara, अकम्पनः Akampana, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, च and, शुकः Shuka, सारणः Sarana, एव indeed, च and.

40020999.author: Translation
40020999.content: Maricha, Prahasta, Mahaparshva, Mahodara, Akampana, Nikumbha, Shuka, and Sarana were among them.

40021000.author: पदार्थः
40021000.content: संह्लादः Samhlada, धूमकेतुः Dhumaketu, च and, महादंष्ट्रः Mahadamshtra, घटोदरः Ghatodara, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महाह्रादः Mahahrada, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, च and, राक्षसः rakshasa.

40021000.author: Translation
40021000.content: Also present were Samhlada, Dhumaketu, Mahadamshtra, Ghatodara, Jambumali, Mahahrada, and the rakshasa Virupaksha.

40021001.author: पदार्थः
40021001.content: सुप्तघ्नः Suptaghna, यज्ञकोपः Yajnakopa, च and, दुर्मुखः Durmukha, दूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, त्रिशिराः Trishira, करवीराक्षः Karaviraksha, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryashatru, च and, राक्षसः rakshasa.

40021001.author: Translation
40021001.content: Among the other rakshasas were Suptaghna, Yajnakopa, Durmukha, Dushana, Khara, Trishira, Karaviraksha, and Suryashatru.

40021002.author: पदार्थः
40021002.content: महाकायो Mahakaya, अतिकायश्च Atikaya, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devantaka and Narantaka, एतैः by these, सर्वैः all, परिवृतो surrounded, महावीर्यो of great valor, महाबलः of great strength.

40021002.author: Translation
40021002.content: Surrounded by all these, namely Mahakaya, Atikaya, Devantaka, and Narantaka, was one of immense valor and strength.

40021003.author: पदार्थः
40021003.content: रावणस्य Ravana's, आर्यकः grandfather, सैन्यं army, सुमाली Sumali, प्रविवेश entered, ह indeed, स He, दैवतगणान् hosts of gods, सर्वान् all, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, शितैः sharp, व्यध्वंसयत् destroyed, सुसङ्क्रुद्धो greatly enraged, वायुर् wind, जलधरानिव like clouds.

40021003.author: Translation
40021003.content: Indeed, Sumali, Ravana's grandfather, entered the army and, greatly enraged, destroyed all the hosts of gods with sharp, various weapons, just as the wind scatters clouds.

40021004.author: पदार्थः
40021004.content: तत् That, दैवतबलं army of gods, राम O Rama, हन्यमानं being killed, निशाचरैः by the night-wanderers, प्रणुन्नं driven away, सर्वतो from all, दिग्भ्यः directions, सिंहनुन्ना driven by lions, मृगा deer, इव like.

40021004.author: Translation
40021004.content: O Rama, that army of gods, being killed by the night-wanderers, was driven away from all directions, just like deer are scattered by lions.

40021005.author: पदार्थः
40021005.content: एतस्मिन् In this, अन्तरे interval, शूरो brave, वसूनाम् among the Vasus, अष्टमो eighth, वसुः Vasu, सावित्र Savitra, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, प्रविवेश entered, रणाजिरम् the battlefield.

40021005.author: Translation
40021005.content: In this interval, the brave eighth Vasu, renowned as Savitra, entered the battlefield.

40021006.author: पदार्थः
40021006.content: तथा Likewise, आदित्यौ the two Adityas, महावीर्यौ of great valor, त्वष्टा Tvashta, पूषा Pushan, च and, दंशितौ armored, निंर्भयौ fearless, सह with, सैन्येन their army, तदा then, प्राविशतां entered, रणे into battle.

40021006.author: Translation
40021006.content: Likewise, the two Adityas of great valor, Tvashta and Pushan, armored and fearless, then entered the battle with their army.

40021007.author: पदार्थः
40021007.content: ततः then, युद्धम् battle, समभवत् occurred, सुराणाम् of the gods, सह with, राक्षसैः the demons, क्रुद्धानाम् of the enraged, रक्षसाम् of the demons, कीर्तिम् fame, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनाम् of those who do not retreat.

40021007.author: Translation
40021007.content: Then a battle took place between the gods and the demons, who were enraged and renowned for never retreating from combat.

40021008.author: पदार्थः
40021008.content: ततः then, ते those, राक्षसाः demons, सर्वे all, विबुधान् the gods, समरे in battle, स्थितान् standing, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, घोरैः terrible, जघ्नुः struck, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands.

40021008.author: Translation
40021008.content: Then all those demons, using dreadful and various weapons, struck down the gods arrayed in battle by hundreds of thousands.

40021009.author: पदार्थः
40021009.content: देवाः the gods, च and, राक्षसान् the demons, घोरान् dreadful, महाबलपराक्रमान् of great strength and valor, समरे in battle, विमलैः with pure, शस्त्रैः weapons, उपनिन्युः led, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode.

40021009.author: Translation
40021009.content: And the gods, in battle, with their pure weapons, led the dreadful demons of great strength and valor to the abode of Yama.

40021010.author: पदार्थः
40021010.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, सुमाली Sumali, नाम named, राक्षसः demon, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, क्रुद्धः enraged, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, सः he, अभ्यवर्तत attacked.

40021010.author: Translation
40021010.content: O Rama, in the meantime, a demon named Sumali, enraged and wielding various weapons, attacked that army.

40021011.author: पदार्थः
40021011.content: सः he, दैवतबलम् the army of gods, सर्वम् all, नानाप्रहणैः with various weapons, शितैः sharp, व्यध्वंसयत destroyed, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, वायुः wind, जलधरम् a cloud, यथा just as.

40021011.author: Translation
40021011.content: Greatly enraged, he destroyed the entire army of gods with his sharp, various weapons, just as the wind scatters a cloud.

40021012.author: पदार्थः
40021012.content: ते they, महाबाणवर्षैः by great showers of arrows, च and, शूलप्रासैः by spears and javelins, सुदारुणैः very terrible, हन्यमानाः being struck, सुराः gods, सर्वे all, न not, व्यतिष्ठन्त stood firm, संहताः united.

40021012.author: Translation
40021012.content: All the gods, being struck by the very terrible great showers of arrows and spears and javelins, could not stand firm together.

40021013.author: पदार्थः
40021013.content: ततः then, विद्राव्यमाणेषु while being put to flight, दैवतेषु the gods, सुमालिना by Sumali, वसूनाम् among the Vasus, अष्टमः the eighth, क्रुद्धः enraged, सावित्रः Savitra, वै indeed, व्यवस्थितः stood firm.

40021013.author: Translation
40021013.content: Then, as the gods were being put to flight by Sumali, Savitra, the eighth among the Vasus, enraged, stood firm.

40021014.author: पदार्थः
40021014.content: संवृतः surrounded, स्वैरथानीकैः by his own chariot divisions, प्रहरन्तं striking, निशाचरम् the night-ranger, विक्रमेण with valor, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, वारयामास checked, संयुगे in battle.

40021014.author: Translation
40021014.content: The greatly effulgent Savitra, surrounded by his own chariot divisions, checked the attacking demon with his valor in battle.

40021015.author: पदार्थः
40021015.content: ततः then, तयोः between those two, महायुद्धम् a great battle, अभवत् occurred, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising.

40021015.author: Translation
40021015.content: Then, a great and hair-raising battle occurred between those two.

40021016.author: पदार्थः
40021016.content: सुमालिनः of Sumali, वसोः of Vasu, च and, एव indeed, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनोः who do not retreat, ततः then, तस्य his (Sumali's), महाबाणैः by great arrows, वसुना by Vasu, सुमहात्मना by the very great-souled one, निहतः struck down, पन्नगरथः whose chariot was drawn by serpents, क्षणेन in a moment, विनिपातितः was overthrown.

40021016.author: Translation
40021016.content: Then, in a moment, the chariot of Sumali, who, along with Vasu, did not retreat in battles, was struck down and overthrown by the great arrows of the very great-souled Vasu.

40021017.author: पदार्थः
40021017.content: हत्वा having destroyed, तु indeed, संयुगे in battle, तस्य his, रथं chariot, बाणशतैश्चितम् covered with hundreds of arrows, गदां mace, तस्य his, वधार्थाय for the purpose of killing, वसुः Vasu, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand.

40021017.author: Translation
40021017.content: Vasu, having destroyed Sumali's chariot which was covered with hundreds of arrows in battle, then took up his mace with his hand for the purpose of killing him.

40021018.author: पदार्थः
40021018.content: ततः then, प्रगृह्य having grasped, दीप्ताग्रां having a blazing tip, कालदण्डोपमां resembling the staff of Yama, गदाम् mace, तां that, मूर्ध्नि on the head, पातयामास he struck down, सावित्रो Savitri's son (Vasu), वै indeed, सुमालिनः of Sumali.

40021018.author: Translation
40021018.content: Then, Savitri's son Vasu, having firmly grasped that mace with its blazing tip resembling the staff of Yama, struck it down upon Sumali's head.

40021019.author: पदार्थः
40021019.content: सा that, तस्योपरि upon him, च and, उल्काभा resembling a meteor, पतन्तीव as if falling, बभौ shone, गदा mace, इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता released by Indra, गर्जन्ती roaring, गिराविव as if on a mountain, महाशनिः a great thunderbolt.

40021019.author: Translation
40021019.content: That mace, resembling a falling meteor, shone as it descended upon him, like a great thunderbolt released by Indra roaring down upon a mountain.

40021020.author: पदार्थः
40021020.content: तस्य his, नैव neither, अस्थि bone, न nor, शिरो head, न nor, मांसं flesh, ददृशे was seen, तदा then, गदया by the mace, भस्मतां to ashes, नीतं brought, निहतस्य of the one killed, रणाजिरे in the battlefield.

40021020.author: Translation
40021020.content: Then, neither his bone, nor head, nor flesh was seen, as the mace had reduced the slain Sumali to ashes on the battlefield.

40021021.author: पदार्थः
40021021.content: तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, निहतं killed, सङ्ख्ये in battle, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, ते those, समन्ततः from all sides, व्यद्रवन् they fled, सहिताः together, सर्वे all, क्रोशमानाः crying out, परस्परम् to each other, विद्राव्यमाणा being put to flight, वसुना by Vasu, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, न not, अवतस्थिरे stood firm.

40021021.author: Translation
40021021.content: Having seen Sumali killed in battle, all those Rakshasas fled together from all sides, crying out to each other, and being driven away by Vasu, they could not stand firm.
